You have Atlassian MCP tools available but they are DEFERRED. First run:
ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_search" and max_results 5.

Context: Zimmermann Salesforce PWA Kit storefront, Confluence space key SFCC. I am planning Jira story SFCC-236 "Product Card Shared Component" — ONE shared product card component with display variations for Homepage, PLP, Wishlist, and a Recently Viewed Full History page, driven by a style prop. I need to know what each of those surfaces specifies the product tile must CONTAIN, so I can tell whether one component can genuinely serve all four.

The project's functional requirements are split across Confluence pages named like "04.1.8 Product, Catalogue and PDP" (Req ID prefix PRD), "04.1.9 Search and Recommendations" (prefix SPR), "04.1.12 Price, Currency and Promotions" (prefix PRC). Each is a big table with columns: Req ID | Functional Area | Sub-Functional Area | Requirement | Owner | Storefront | Config/Custom | Status | Comments | User Story Link. Rows rendered with ~~strikethrough~~ are OUT OF SCOPE.

TASK A — Wishlist. Read page ID 302022672 ("04.1.11 Customers, Account, CRM Sync") in full. Extract VERBATIM every row whose Requirement or Comments mentions "wishlist" or "saved items". For each, give Req ID, the exact Requirement text, Status, Comments, and whether it is struck through. I especially need: what is displayed for each wishlist entry (image? name? price? size? colour? add-to-bag? remove?), whether wishlist is saved at product or SKU/size level, and whether the wishlist page uses a grid of tiles.

TASK B — Homepage. Find the functional-requirements page covering the Homepage / content pages. Try mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_search with spaces_filter="SFCC" for: "04.1 Homepage", "homepage requirements", "HPC-", "Home Page", "content pages requirements". A requirement ID prefix "HPC" is known to exist in this project. Read whatever page defines HPC requirements. Extract VERBATIM any row that specifies a product tile / product card / product grid / product carousel on the homepage — what it must contain and how products are selected. If the Homepage requirements page specifies NOTHING about product tile contents, say so explicitly.

TASK C — cross-surface price display. I already have PRC-08, PRC-09, PRC-33 (they list PLP tiles, PDP, mini-bag, cart, checkout, wishlist, recommended product tiles, order history as surfaces that must show price consistently, and PRC-09 adds was/now sale pricing). Do NOT re-report those. Only tell me if you find an ADDITIONAL requirement elsewhere that constrains what a tile shows on Wishlist or Homepage specifically.

For every page you read, report: exact page title, page ID, version number from metadata, and any last-updated date stated in the page body.

CRITICAL: explicitly flag any place where a Wishlist or Homepage tile is specified to contain something a PLP tile does not, or vice versa — that is the thing that would break a single shared component. And explicitly say if a surface has NO documented tile spec at all.

Do NOT create, update, or comment on any Confluence page. Read-only. Do not write any files. Return findings directly as your final message.

- **SPR-16**: product badges (RUNWAY, CAMPAIGN, etc.), multiple per product
- **SPR-17**: Quick Add to Bag with size prompt, without navigating to PDP

None appear in any wishlist requirement. Conversely CRM-136/137 require an add-to-bag that **removes the item from the wishlist on success** — a side effect a PLP quick-add must not have.

### 5. Surfaces with NO documented tile spec at all

- **Homepage** — no tile contents, no selection logic, no layout, no price guarantee. Only HPC-009's "product spotlights" and an unresolved SFCC-vs-Contentful data-source question (HPC-001).
- **Wishlist page layout** — contents specified (CRM-132), but grid/tile/card/responsive layout is never stated anywhere. 04.1.18 (303333385 v3) only says "The system will deliver page templates for login, registration, password reset, order history, order details, returns history, address book, saved payments and **wishlist**" — a template will exist; its shape is undefined.
- **Recently Viewed Full History page** — **does not exist as a requirement.** The only trace is **PRD-027** (04.1.8, v18), Confirmed: *"The system should display a 'Recently Viewed' carousel based on the customer's browsing session history"*, with **Comments: "Updated design: not a carousel but with button 'See full history'"**. That comment is the sole documentary basis for the whole page. **SPR-61** scopes Recently Viewed to "the PDP and Cart page" only. No requirement defines the full-history page's existence, route, tile contents, layout, or pagination. Treat it as undocumented scope.

### Net read for SFCC-236

One component can plausibly serve **PLP + Search + Homepage**, since Homepage is undefined and Search matches PLP almost exactly (SPR-10 ≈ SPR-56). **Wishlist is the outlier** — it needs printed size + colour, a "What's Now" price type, a region-unavailable greyed state, a VIC price state, and destructive add-to-bag. That's five variations, three of which change the *data contract*, not just presentation. A single `style` prop won't cover it; you'll need a discriminated variant on the props type. And **Recently Viewed Full History has no spec to build against at all** — flag it as blocked before it's committed to a sprint.
